vlm.metric_note: acc / real_acc / fake_acc from the parsed verdict, unparsed = wrong; *_drop leave unparsed answers out (the authors' cal_metrics.py); AUROC / AP from the fake-minus-real logit at the verdict token (n_unscored: a parsed verdict without a verdict token enters AUROC / AP with logit 0, P(fake) 0.5). acc_pooled counts every scored (generator, image) pair once: a real pool shared by several generators (ufd, synthbuster layouts) is counted once per generator; the headline acc is the balanced mean over generators and is unaffected
